title: Nucleic acid-templated toluidine blue O assemblies as colorimetric probes for point-of-care nucleic acid tests.
authors: Selva Sharma, Arumugam; Lee, Ji Hyeok; Ryou, Sung Min; Lee, Nae Yoon
one_liner_zh: 该文利用DNA模板诱导甲苯胺蓝O聚集实现比色核酸检测，虽涉及DNA结合与自动对接，但核心是核酸扩增检测应用，非TF-DNA互作机制或AI/物理模拟方法研究。
abstract: This study systematically investigated the metachromatic properties of toluidine blue O (TBO) in the presence of polyanions using spectroscopic techniques. Spectroscopic analyses demonstrated the formation of DNA-templated H-type aggregates of TBO. Fourier-transform infrared (FT-IR) and optical microscopy analyses were carried out to study the binding of TBO to DNA and subsequent dye aggregation. Auto-docking studies were performed to identify the binding sites of TBO in DNA. DNA-templated metachromasia of TBO was used to develop a colorimetric method for monitoring polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP). The TBO colorimetric assay showed a significant color shift from blue to purple for PCR and LAMP reactions targeting the metal-responsive transcription factor 1 (MTF-1), a biomarker for osteoarthritis, and the Streptococcus pneumoniae gene, respectively, with a limit of detection as low as 1 pg/muL (for both MTF-1 and S. pneumoniae). The aggregation of TBO was highly specific to the DNA amplicons and was not influenced by the PCR or LAMP reagents. The practical utility of this colorimetric method for point-of-care testing in pediatric diagnosis was confirmed by its successful application in the detection of S. pneumoniae in artificial urine samples.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用光谱技术系统研究了甲苯胺蓝O（TBO）在多聚阴离子存在下的异染性特性。光谱分析表明，TBO形成了以DNA为模板的H型聚集体。通过傅里叶变换红外光谱（FT-IR）和光学显微镜分析，研究了TBO与DNA的结合及随后的染料聚集过程。采用自动对接研究确定了TBO在DNA中的结合位点。利用TBO的DNA模板异染性，开发了一种用于监测聚合酶链反应（PCR）和环介导等温扩增（LAMP）的比色方法。针对骨关节炎生物标志物金属反应转录因子1（MTF-1）和肺炎链球菌基因的PCR及LAMP反应，TBO比色测定显示出从蓝色到紫色的显著颜色变化，检测限低至1 pg/μL（对MTF-1和肺炎链球菌均适用）。TBO的聚集对DNA扩增子具有高度特异性，且不受PCR或LAMP试剂的影响。该方法在人工尿液样本中成功检测肺炎链球菌，证实了其在儿科诊断中用于即时检测的实际应用价值。
